lines.1: Here I am, openly skipping class beside a teacher who knowingly lets me.
lines.3: And it isn't because we're rebelling against society or anything grand like that.
lines.4: I feel tired, so I'm taking a break. That's all.
lines.7: 「Are you free next period too, or do you have a class?」
lines.8: 「I have a lesson with Class A.」
lines.10: 「...If we're found, I'll claim I felt sick.」
lines.11: 「This is a blind spot. We won't be found.」
lines.12: 「Mr. Tsuchinaga is keeping watch as our scout as well.」
lines.16: 「Inori, I'm starting to enjoy this pace.」
lines.21: This was the pace that suited us.
